label: No occurring act produces its own…: For every a, Occurs a implies not produces a
term: no occurring act produces its own bearer’s existence
definition: For every a, Occurs a implies not produces a (bearer a). This restricts the supplied productive relation; it does not forbid all intrinsic explanation, maintenance, self-change, temporal feedback or a source-free infinite chain.
note: Analyst registration of the pre-existing branch theorem, with no new relation, historical claim or premise defense. Meaning and rival/application limits: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md. An occurring embodied action motivates a bearer/act distinction, but no undisputed empirical instance of bare existence production is supplied. Ordinary feedback and intrinsic noncausal explanation are near misses. Priority, its transitivity/irreflexivity and the abstraction from activity to existential production must be justified independently against those rivals; no such generalization is certified here. The origin-to-exercise bridge (DEF 9022c4bf, statement be90bb15) uses produces in this same sense, production of the resultant individual's being; whether ordinary causes of coming-to-be, such as a builder making a house, produce being in this sense is an OPEN step of that bridge, not an instance supplied here.
